question: Can the fixed six-edge loop's complete second 24-site ideal public charge record be enumerated after its complete first record and edge-0 action, and does the frozen five-round caller already provide a stateful next-first-observation handoff?
role: Two independent bounded prerequisites: exact ideal full-second-record feasibility and frozen public/caller interface audit; neither licenses noisy histories or a general D4 transition
source_basis: Jing Appendix A.2/A.4 ordered flux-free charge projections and red-X correction
J6L/J6M one periodic L=2 graph and common vacuum orbit
J6O full-public fixed path and J6P first-record/action binding

common.geometry_state: Pinned periodic L=2 six-red-edge simple loop [0,1,32,30,34,35] on one common vacuum orbit; private physical red-X support and ideal projectors, no readout noise
common.timing: Physical error; full eligible first 24-site binary charge record; public edge-0 red-X correction; full eligible second 24-site binary charge record; only then audit whether a next-first stateful caller interface exists
common.public_private: Flux/charge/vacuum arrays are public; exact operator masks, physical error support, orbit and selection diagnostics remain private. Deterministic stars are included as measured +1 outcomes, not omitted instrumentation. The action is a relation-free public edge ID. No hidden truth is returned to a decoder.
common.independent_unit: One fixed exact vacuum orbit and error geometry with rational Born masses; no stochastic sampling or statistical uncertainty

full_second_loop.first_gate: Verify exactly six variable first sites and 16 positive full first records; all other eligible first stars are deterministic +1.
full_second_loop.second_gate: For every positive first record, calculate exact one-site second marginals on every eligible second star; union all sites with non-deterministic conditional marginals. If union exceeds six, censor full joint before enumeration. All other eligible sites must have deterministic conditional outcomes and commute on actual sector.
full_second_loop.joint_method: For m first and n conditionally variable second stars, compute the exact ordered Born coefficient for <P_first P_second P_first> by summing all first-left/first-right subsets and applying a Walsh-Hadamard transform to all first/second bit strings. Compare normalization and one-site marginals to independent direct projector checks. Fill each full 24-site second record from its joint variable bits and prefix-deterministic bits.

stateful_next_round_interface.audit: Read pinned J6P adapter and frozen integrated-history public API; require an explicit postselected-state token/output and a later first-observation input path bound to that token. If absent, classify not integrated and list the missing interface, not a physical impossibility. Verify source hashes unchanged after audit.
stateful_next_round_interface.dependency: This branch is read-only and independent of exact full-second success; a future numeric next-round test depends on both branches passing.

acceptance: All six source pins pass before any evaluation
Actual-sector eligibility/commutation, exact rational nonnegative normalized joint law, direct marginal replay and 24-site public shape pass or the loop branch censors at its fixed caps
Stateful caller audit reports explicit present/absent fields and no invented feedback
No change to frozen five-round caller/J6P adapter; zero histories, arms, bootstrap and new dependencies
No decoder risk, noisy feedback, threshold, or physical generalization from one exact fixture
stop_rule: Run the two independent branches sequentially within the common 60-CPU-second cap. On pin, incidence, commutation, negative mass or normalization drift fail closed. On six-site, 262144-term, 1024-row or time cap, censor only full-second branch, retain independent interface audit, never widen caps post hoc.
